final_netlist:
.subckt dut vin1 vin2 vout vcm vdd vss ibias
* bias: IREF diode, mirrored 2:14 to tail (~70 uA)
Mb1 ibias ibias vss vss nfet W=2 L=0.5 m=2
Mt  tail  ibias vss vss nfet W=2 L=0.5 m=14
* tail bypass: full gm of M2 at HF, current-source tail at DC
Ct  tail  vss 10p
* asymmetric NMOS pair 1:8 (M1 replica on vcm, M2 main device on summing node)
M1  d1   vcm  tail vss nfet W=7.5 L=0.18
M2  vout nx   tail vss nfet W=60 L=0.18
* PMOS mirror 1:8; M4 gate DC-biased from d1, AC-driven from nx (current reuse)
M3  d1   d1   vdd  vdd pfet W=7.5 L=0.18
M4  vout g4   vdd  vdd pfet W=60 L=0.18
Rb  d1   g4   1meg
Cc  nx   g4   1p
* inverting feedback, gain = -Rf/R1 = -C1/Cf (compensated divider)
R1  vin1 nx   200k
Rf  nx   vout 24k
C1  vin1 nx   96f
Cf  nx   vout 800f
.ends
